subject: Intro + Demo — BrightLane traffic snapshot & timeline
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@brightlane.co>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in a quick demo—signed up today

Hey Karthik,

We just signed up for Redwood (trial) and ran a couple of small embedding tests — impressed so far. I'm Samir on the infra team at BrightLane. We'd love a short demo to see how Redwood would perform for our search/rerank pipeline and to understand expected token costs.

Quick context: BrightLane is an e-commerce search company. Typical requests are short user queries (8–20 tokens) + a 1k token product context fetch; we peak at ~150 reqs/sec during flash sales but average is ~8–12 rps. We have a mid-term timeline to evaluate for a pilot in Q3.

Can you share a few short qualification questions so we can confirm the right demo flow? Also open to a 30 min slot next week — mornings PST work best.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Infra Engineer | BrightLane
--
Samir Patel
BrightLane, Inc.
@samir_p | samir@brightlane.co
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightlane.co>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a quick demo—signed up today

Hi Samir — welcome and thanks for signing up. I can take the demo and Connor (solutions) will join for any throughput/ops detail. A few quick questions so we tailor the session: 

1) Is the 150 reqs/sec figure a sustained peak or a short burst (seconds vs minutes)?
2) What percent of requests need live rerank/generation vs read-only embedding lookups?
3) Target latency SLO for end-to-end query? (p50/p95 targets)
4) Any constraints on private data — will you need VPC/on-prem or is hosted acceptable for a pilot?
5) Do you have a small sample of traffic we can use to scope batching/kv-cache? (CSV or synthetic profile is fine)

I can propose three 30-min slots next week: Tue 6/17 9:30–10:00 PST, Wed 6/18 11:00–11:30 PST, Thu 6/19 8:30–9:00 PST. If none work, share a couple options and we’ll adjust.

I attached a one-pager with what we usually cover for pilot demos and an example traffic CSV template.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference
Attachments: redwood-demo-guide.pdf, sample_traffic.csv
From: Rachel Zhou <rachel@brightlane.co>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a quick demo—signed up today

Hi Karthik — thanks for the quick response. A few answers:

1) The 150 rps was a short burst during last week's promotion — typically bursts last 3–8 minutes. Sustained peaks are more like 30–40 rps.
2) ~60% of traffic will be rerank/generation (we add a short prompt + rerank step), the rest are embeddings-only.
3) p50 target is 150ms, p95 around 600ms — we know the p95 is tough but it's what product needs.
4) Hosted is fine for the pilot; we'll evaluate private deployment later.
5) Attached a redacted sample traffic CSV and a very small qps trace.

Could we take Wed 6/18 11:00–11:30 PST? If possible, shift to 11:15–11:45 PST due to another recurring meeting.

Thanks,
Rachel Zhou
Platform Eng | BrightLane
Attachments: brightlane_sample_traffic.csv
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Zhou <rachel@brightlane.co>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a quick demo—signed up today

Thanks Rachel — that timing works. I moved the slot to 11:15–11:45 PST and sent a calendar invite (Google Meet). Connor — can you pick up the invite and prep a short throughput slide around batching + KV cache for the traffic profile?

Action items:
- BrightLane: confirm the attached CSV is representative (we received brightlane_sample_traffic.csv).
- Connor (internal): prepare 2 slides — expected batching behavior and suggested starter config (model variant, quantization heuristics).
- Karthik: run a quick pre-demo check against the sample and note any model-size constraints.

I attached the internal demo checklist and the one-pager again for Rachel.

Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Zhou <rachel@brightlane.co>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 09:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a quick demo—signed up today

On Mon, Jun 16, 2025 at 11:04 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Thanks Rachel — that timing works. I moved the slot to 11:15–11:45 PST and sent a calendar invite (Google Meet). Connor — can you pick up the invite and prep a short throughput slide around batching + KV cache for the traffic profile?

Got it — I'll pull the CSV into our sandbox and run a quick sampling pass. Preliminary read: with ~1k token contexts and 8–20 token prompts, we can expect to batch effectively in hosted mode but we'll want to tune the batching window to avoid p95 regressions during bursts. I'll include a suggested starter config and a rough cost-per-1k-requests estimate in the deck.

See you Wed 6/18 at 11:15 PST.

Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
